name: Admin Angular JS
tagline: The AngularJS back office (Commerce Manager) for the Virto Commerce Platform. Without an admin UI module the platform runs API only.

readme.overview: The AngularJS back office of Virto Commerce — Commerce Manager. It used to be part of the platform; from platform 3.1093.0 the platform is API only and this module brings the AngularJS admin back. Install it to keep the admin you have today; every module's AngularJS screens load into it unchanged. It works alone, or next to [Admin Shell](https://github.com/VirtoCommerce/vc-module-admin-shell), the Vue admin: either one can own the site root, and Admin Shell embeds the AngularJS screens that have no Vue version yet.
keyFeatures: **The AngularJS admin as it was:** the same page, scripts, styles, images, templates and translations, at the same URLs (`/dist/app.js`, `/images/...`, `/$(Platform)/Scripts/...`).
**Module screens unchanged:** each module's AngularJS bundle (`dist/app.js`, `dist/style.css`) is listed by `GET /api/apps/platform/manifest` and loaded by the admin, as before.
**Site root or app path:** served at `/` when it owns the site root, and always at `/apps/platform/`, where Admin Shell embeds it when the shell owns the root.
**Turn off without uninstalling:** `VirtoCommerce:PlatformUI:Enable = false` keeps the page closed; the API is not affected.
**No database, no settings, no permissions** of its own. Who may sign in is the platform's admin UI access policy (`VirtoCommerce:PlatformUI:Access`).

notes.forAnalyst: The back office most teams use today, the Commerce Manager, delivered as a module. A platform without it or Admin Shell has no back office screen at all; the APIs still run.
notes.forArchitect: Until platform 3.1092 the AngularJS admin was built into the platform. This module now carries the same page, scripts, styles and translations and maps the page itself (`hosting="Endpoint"`, app id `platform`, priority 100). With Admin Shell installed too, it owns the site root unless `VirtoCommerce:PlatformUI:RootApp` says otherwise, and it stays reachable at `/apps/platform/`. It has no database, settings or permissions of its own: who may sign in is decided by the platform's admin UI access policy.
notes.forDeveloper: Module screens written for AngularJS keep working: each module's `dist/app.js` and `dist/style.css` bundles are loaded by this module as before. To close the page without uninstalling, set `VirtoCommerce:PlatformUI:Enable` to `false`; the API keeps running. Its version follows the platform's, so upgrade the two together.
reachForItWhen: Every installation that uses the Commerce Manager today. After upgrading the platform past 3.1092, add this module to the package or the back office disappears
Running it beside Admin Shell while screens move to Vue, with `RootApp` choosing which one opens at `/`
doNotReachForItWhen: API-only hosts, such as a scaled-out storefront tier. Leave it out and the host serves no back office
New back-office screens. Build them as Admin Shell plugins; the AngularJS UI is maintained, not extended
